mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medicines (id, medicine_code, medicine_name, medicine_name_pinyin, medicine_name_pinyin_abbr, registered_name, registered_name_pinyin, registered_name_pinyin_abbr, registered_medicine_model, reality_medicine_model, registered_outlook, reality_outlook, material_name, factor, unit, min_unit, company_name, approval_code, standard_code, indication, description, otc, poisonous, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{medicineCode}, #{medicineName}, #{medicineNamePinyin}, #{medicineNamePinyinAbbr}, #{registeredName}, #{registeredNamePinyin}, #{registeredNamePinyinAbbr}, #{registeredMedicineModel}, #{realityMedicineModel}, #{registeredOutlook}, #{realityOutlook}, #{materialName}, #{factor}, #{unit}, #{minUnit}, #{companyName}, #{approvalCode}, #{standardCode}, #{indication}, #{description}, #{otc}, #{poisonous}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE medicines SET medicine_code=#{medicineCode}, medicine_name=#{medicineName}, medicine_name_pinyin=#{medicineNamePinyin}, medicine_name_pinyin_abbr=#{medicineNamePinyinAbbr}, registered_name=#{registeredName}, registered_name_pinyin=#{registeredNamePinyin}, registered_name_pinyin_abbr=#{registeredNamePinyinAbbr}, registered_medicine_model=#{registeredMedicineModel}, reality_medicine_model=#{realityMedicineModel}, registered_outlook=#{registeredOutlook}, reality_outlook=#{realityOutlook}, material_name=#{materialName}, factor=#{factor}, unit=#{unit}, min_unit=#{minUnit}, company_name=#{companyName}, approval_code=#{approvalCode}, standard_code=#{standardCode}, indication=#{indication}, description=#{description}, otc=#{otc}, poisonous=#{poisonous}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM medicines WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id FROM medicines WHERE medicine_code = #{medicineCode} AND medicine_name = #{medicineName} AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM medicines
AND id = #{id}
AND deleted_at > 0
AND deleted_at = 0
AND (
medicine_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR medicine_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR medicine_name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR medicine_name_pinyin_abbr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR registered_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR registered_name_pinyin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR registered_name_pinyin_abbr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%')
)
